reader_player_purpose: What should a new reader know before the game starts? | The public start-here cluster frames HECTON-8 as salvage contract, professional guilt and hard constraints without spoiling final receivers.

Can hard-sci-fi logistics be navigable instead of a wall of exposition? | The system/ships cluster groups no-FTL, Aegir route, carrier custody and drop-capsule constraints into one readable navigation lane.
How do we make the colony human without cheap personal melodrama? | The colony/workers cluster makes people legible through jobs and evidence, not relatives of the protagonist.
Can a resource page explain ecology without flattening life into loot? | The resource/ecology cluster connects geology, blue debt, native life and Atlas repair misuse as process chains.
How should public/wiki material discuss endings without destroying discovery? | The endings cluster must be spoiler-gated and organized by receiver/custody consequences, not good/bad moral labels.
